question: In △ABC, ∠A = 68°. If I is the incentre of the triangle, then the measure of ∠BIC is:
solution:
Given:

In △ABC, ∠A = 68°

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd904fc875827ea15b6b201dfa47458cd8643a9d23b343d1b455fc440cc54f50.png] 

ΔABC is a triangle with incenter I. 

So, ∠BIC = 90° + {1 over 2} × ∠BAC

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd904fc875827ea15b6b201dfa47458cd8643a9d23b343d1b455fc440cc54f50.png] 

According to the concept,

∠BIC = 90° + {1 over 2} × ∠BAC

⇒ ∠BIC = 90° + {1 over 2} × 68°

⇒ ∠BIC = 90° + 34°

⇒ ∠BIC = 124°

**∴ The measure of ∠BIC is 124°.**
